body: The strongest academic result is **Lopez-Lira & Tang**. ChatGPT's sentiment scores on news headlines significantly predict next-day returns and outperform older sentiment methods ([arXiv v6](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2304.07619v6)). But per-headline accuracy is only about 51%, and the signal emerges only across many firms and days ([Fortune](https://fortune.com/2023/04/21/chat-gpt-market-predicting-stock-price-movements/)). Later work shows that **LLM memorisation of past data inflates apparent predictability**. That makes backtests on periods the model was trained on unreliable ([Gao, Jiang & Yan](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2512.23847); [The Memorization Problem](https://arxiv.org/html/2504.14765v2)). Live tests are sobering. In Alpha Arena Season 1 (crypto, $10k each), **four of six models lost money and GPT-5 lost about 62%**, mainly from overtrading costs ([Benzinga](https://benzinga.com/crypto/cryptocurrency/25/11/48651974/chatgpt-lost-63-trying-to-trade-crypto-but-one-china-ai-made-a-healthy-profit); [Protos](https://protos.com/llm-crypto-trading-contest-finds-llms-cant-trade-crypto)). In Season 1.5 on US stocks, **only 6 of 32 entries finished positive** ([Forklog](https://forklog.com/en/news/ai-model-grok-4-2-triumphs-in-trading-tournament)). Nof1's founder said it is not yet feasible to hand an LLM money to trade on its own ([KuCoin News](https://www.kucoin.com/news/flash/ai-trading-models-struggle-in-live-market-tests-majority-of-systems-report-losses)). In Finder's 2026 AI portfolio showdown, **every aggressive AI portfolio lost money in October 2026** and trailed the Russell 2000 ([Finder AU](https://www.finder.com.au/insights/who-let-the-bots-out-2026-ai-portfolio-performance-showdown)). The headline "ChatGPT beat the market by 72%" results come from short paper portfolios ([Crypto Briefing](https://cryptobriefing.com/chatgpt-leads-rallies-ai-stock-market-arena/)). One study found ChatGPT portfolios putting **18–20% in Nvidia** ([Altiorem](https://altiorem.org/?p=25299)), so these results look like a concentrated tech bet in a strong tech market rather than demonstrated skill. The longest real-money record belongs to the **AIEQ ETF**, which returned about 9.7% a year against 14.2% for SPY over about nine years, at a 0.80% fee ([PortfoliosLab](https://portfolioslab.com/tools/stock-comparison/AIEQ/SPY)).
title: AI stock picking playbook › What the evidence says

body: **Summary:** Specialty chemical companies sell chemistry know-how (fluorination, nitration, process efficiency) to global agrochemical, pharma, polymer and refrigerant makers, plus import substitutes into India. Profit comes from complex-chemistry custom synthesis (CSM) contracts, where margins and stickiness are highest, while plain intermediates are priced against China. Key metrics: volume growth, gross margin per kg, EBITDA margin, asset turns (1.0–1.5x for new plants, which is why capex is lumpy), capex in progress, CSM order book and customer count, working capital days, and product concentration. Cycle drivers: China supply (capacity overbuild and dumping in 2023–26), global destocking (2023–24), agrochemical channel inventory, crude and feedstock prices, anti-dumping duties, the US tariff gap against China, and the monsoon for domestic agrochemicals. Lead indicators: China PPI and chemical prices, DGTR anti-dumping notifications, US agrochemical channel commentary (Corteva, FMC), Indian chemical export data from the Commerce Ministry, IMD monsoon. Winners (SRF, PI Industries, Navin, Clean Science) climbed the complexity ladder, held proprietary processes and built multi-year innovator relationships. Losers were commodity-like intermediates priced off China, or one-molecule firms. Valuation: P/E 50–80x at the 2021 China+1 peak, de-rated to 25–45x in 2023–25. Nov 2026: ICRA (31 Aug 2026) sees domestic-led volume recovery, but global overcapacity caps prices. CRISIL expects only ~6% revenue growth in FY27. Traps: extrapolating China+1, and capex before contracts. Sources: [1](https://www.icra.in/Research/ViewResearchReport/domestic-led-volume-recovery-supports-growth-global-overcapacity-caps-prices/7086) · [2](https://upstox.com/news/business-news/latest-updates/specialty-chemical-makers-to-see-6-revenue-growth-this-fiscal-margins-under-pressure-crisil/article-196278/) · [3](https://easternherald.com/2026/08/27/india-chemicals-upl-pidilite-srf-q1-fy27-august-2026/) · [4](https://www.indianchemicalnews.com/general/india-pesticides-q2-profit-falls-44-to-rs-18-crore-as-revenue-declines-216-32562)
